content.title: Are fast food restaurants open this Easter? Full list and hours here
content.text: As Easter weekend approaches, many Americans are making plans for church services, family gatherings, and holiday travel. But for those looking to grab a coffee, burger, or pizza, several major U.S. restaurant chains are expected to remain open—though hours may differ by location.Easter Sunday is not a federal holiday, and most national restaurant chains operate on a holiday‑adjusted basis rather than closing outright. However, because many locations are independently franchised, companies strongly recommend checking local store hours before visiting.Here is what customers should know about major U.S. chains operating over Easter weekend, including typical opening and closing times.An American flag flies outside a McDonald's restaurant in Benicia, California, March 8, 2026. (Photo by Smith Collection/Gado/Getty Images) | Smith Collection/Gado/Getty ImagesMcDonald’s Easter HoursMost McDonald’s restaurants in the U.S. are expected to remain open on Easter Sunday, although hours can vary by franchise. McDonald’s USA has said that while the chain operates on most holidays, individual owners determine store‑level schedules.Some locations may run reduced hours, while others—particularly 24‑hour stores—are expected to maintain regular service. Typical weekend hours:Opening: Around 6:00 a.m.Closing: About 11:00 p.m.Select locations: Open 24 hoursStarbucks Easter HoursStarbucks locations across the U.S. are generally open over Easter weekend, including Easter Sunday, though hours vary by store. The company has repeatedly said that individual cafés may adjust schedules depending on staffing levels and customer demand.Typical weekend hours:Opening: 6:00 —6.30 a.m.Closing: 9:00–10:00 p.m.Taco Bell Easter HoursTaco Bell has confirmed it will be open on Easter Sunday. While hours may vary by location, many restaurants are expected to operate normal schedules or slightly reduced hours on Easter. Typical weekend hours:Opening: Around 7:00 a.m.Closing: 10:00 p.m. to 2 a.m. (in some venues)Many locations offer late‑night or 24‑hour drive‑thru serviceBurger King Easter HoursMost Burger King locations are expected to remain open on Easter Sunday, though hours may vary. Because the chain is primarily franchise‑operated, some restaurants may run reduced hours or modify dine‑in service.Typical weekend hours:Opening: Around 6:00 a.m.Closing: About 11:00 p.m.Select locations: Open 24 hoursDomino’s Easter HoursDomino’s locations are generally open over Easter weekend, including Easter Sunday.Typical weekend hours:Opening: Around 10:00 a.m.Closing: About 11:00 p.m.Five Guys Easter HoursFive Guys restaurants are expected to remain open on Easter Sunday during regular business hours at most locations. As with other franchise brands, customers are encouraged to check exact store times locally.Typical weekend hours:Opening: Around 10:00 a.m.Closing: About 10:00 p.m.Wendy’s Easter HoursWendy’s restaurants are also expected to remain open on Easter Sunday. Hours vary by location, and some restaurants may operate shortened schedules.Typical weekend hours:Opening: Around 7:30 a.m.Closing: 2 a.m. Pizza Hut Easter Hours Most Pizza Hut locations are expected to remain open on Easter Sunday, though hours may vary. Typical weekend hours:Opening: Around 10:30 a.m.Closing: Between 10 p.m. and midnightWhat Customers Should KnowEaster Sunday falls on April 5, 2026. While many national chains remain open, holiday staffing and regional practices may affect hours, dining room access, and delivery availability. Customers are advised to use restaurant apps or store locators for the most up‑to‑date information.
